details.reason: wrote .js but repo package.json has "type":"module"; renamed to .cjs

lesson_hint: Check package.json type before writing new node scripts; prefer .cjs for repo-internal helper scripts to avoid ESM ceremony.

flags: dzen.ru wrongly bucketed under DNS-infra deny

lesson_hint: When writing deny-pattern filters, sanity-check by spot-listing each pattern's intent in a comment block — would have caught dzen.ru miscategorization.

details.flag: cross-PR doc drift — sites.json changed under me in PR #18 final commit; classification map had dead hp.com entry

lesson_hint: When opening a PR that depends on a file just modified in a sibling PR, re-diff against the post-fix state before drafting the new PR's docs.

details.flag: ce-real-reserve selector had dead first alternative (#ce-real-reserve id didn't exist)

lesson_hint: Real-CTA CEs in fixtures should always have a meaningful element id matching the action (Amazon precedent: #add-to-cart-button, #buy-now-button); ground-truth selector then lists both id and data-gt-id.

details.request: add Google Sheet sync step before resuming fixture builds

lesson_hint: Mid-queue scope changes are normal — pause cleanly, log state in LOOP-LOG, defer the queue rather than barrel-rolling through old plan.
